name: Hunting Season [BETA]
desc:
Hunting Season is an open-world hunting simulator on Roblox, hunt solo or with friends as you track wildlife, master the stalk, and build your legacy as a skilled hunter.

🐶 DOGS: Hunting dogs are finally here. Track animals by blood trail or scent and train your dog.

Hunts are tense, and rewarding. Read the terrain, learn how animals move, and commit to a clean shot when the moment is right. Bring your best trophies to your lodge and keep upgrading your gear.

🦌  Real world hunting simulation: Realistic hunting that provides an immersive experience.
🗺️  Massive Open-World Maps: Explore huge regions with varied terrain.
🐾  Track, Stalk, Hunt: Learn animal patterns, read the terrain, and plan your approach.
🏡  Hunting Lodges & Trophies: Display your best trophies, show off your rarest animals, and upgrade your lodge over time to build the ultimate trophy showcase.

🖥️ Play on Desktop, Console, Mobile and Tablet!

⚠️ Note: Game is in beta, so anticipate bugs. ⚠️

Version: v0.19.1
